column3: (Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) Mitigated: every form POST must carry an Origin (or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin) matching APP_URL (hono/csrf, 403 otherwise) and cookies are SameSite=Lax; JSON endpoints need a CORS preflight the app never grants. Verified with cross-origin and Origin-less POSTs.
(Non-Storable Content) Intended: pages carry personal sales data and are sent Cache-Control: no-store on purpose; static files set their own caching.
(Suspicious Comments) False positive: matches the word 'from' in plain-English comments in public/app.js; no secrets or hidden endpoints.

(User Controllable HTML Element Attribute) False positive: ?method= is only compared with a constant, and the typed email is reflected in a value attribute escaped by hono/jsx; tested with quote and tag payloads.
(Authentication Request Identified) Informational: marks the sign-in form, nothing to fix.
(Session Management Response Identified) Informational: marks the session and wait cookies, which are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and __Host- prefixed over HTTPS.
(Modern Web Application) Informational only.
(User Agent Fuzzer) Informational only: responses differ by User-Agent because device names are recorded for the sign-in list.
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing) Accepted: the app loads no cross-origin resources and uses no cross-origin-isolated APIs; COOP same-origin and CORP same-origin are set.
(HTTP Only Site) The CI and local sandboxes run over plain http; production runs behind an HTTPS reverse proxy with HSTS and __Host- cookies.
(Private IP Disclosure) Only on Account > Security, which shows the signed-in person the address of their own devices (the Docker gateway in the sandbox).
(Timestamp Disclosure - Unix) False positive: the numbers are cache-busting versions (?v=<branding update time>) and dates the user may see anyway.
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag) Every cookie must stay HttpOnly.
(Cookie without SameSite Attribute) Every cookie must keep SameSite=Lax: part of the CSRF defence.
(Anti-clickjacking Header) X-Frame-Options and frame-ancestors must stay set.
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) nosniff must stay set: uploads are served from the app.
(Content Security Policy Header Not Set) The strict CSP must stay on every page.
(CSP) The CSP must not gain unsafe directives. Only the admin-only email preview allows inline styles (email HTML needs them); signed-out pages, which the baseline sees, have none.
(Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion) Scripts load only from the app itself.
(Vulnerable JS Library) No known-vulnerable client libraries.
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration) No permissive CORS headers.
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set) The Permissions-Policy header must stay set.
